body:
Alternate to the human-passphrase path: Vault.UnlockFromKeyFile verifies a hex-encoded 32-byte key from a local file against the existing canary mechanism, no Argon2 derivation needed. Opt-in via MAILING_LIST_KEY_FILE in main.go's new mailingListAutoUnlock -- generates+persists a key on first boot, reuses it on reboot, so signups survive an unattended redeploy/crash with no operator. Default (unset) behavior unchanged. 6 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit 3cc3aaa. Unblocks S245-02/03/04/05.

⚓ ☃
title: S245-01: real config/file-key vault-unlock mode for mailing-list vault
